{{Quote|Sir, all the patrols are in. Still no&hellip;still no contact from Skywalker or Solo.|Lieutenant Cal Alder, to Major Bren Derlin|audio=Alder-Contact.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Cal Alder''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A highly-trained, expert [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], Alder served with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] during some of the Rebel Alliance's most dangerous operations of the war before receiving assignment to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

Alder was responsible for patrolling Echo Base's outer perimeter under Derlin's command, and he was the [[Alliance Military/Legends|officer]] to inform Derlin that fellow Rebels [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] still had not reported in to the base after Skywalker had gone missing during a routine scouting mission one [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. Despite their absence and its worrying toll on [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], Derlin tasked Alder with closing the base's shield doors for the night, reluctantly trapping both missing men out in the Hoth cold.

During the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Alder helped to direct Rebel [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] groups against the invading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blizzard Force/Legends|forces]] and survived the [[Ground warfare/Legends|engagement]]. Years later, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he helped to organize the [[DarkStryder Campaign]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation to stop the rogue Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].

==Biography==
===Early war and Echo Base service===
{{Quote|Your Highness, there's nothing more we can do tonight. The shield doors ''must'' be closed." ''[Leia nods reluctantly]'' "Close the doors.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Major Bren Derlin orders Cal Alder to close Echo Base's shield doors for the night|audio=DerlinAndAlder.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:AlderLeia-ESB.png|thumb|left|300px|Cal Alder and Bren Derlin gain Leia Organa's permission to close Echo Base's shield doors.]]
A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> Cal Alder was a highly-trained,<ref name="BTM" /> expert [[Scout/Legends|scout]].<ref name="Hoth Limited">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Cal Alder}}</ref> He<ref name="SWFC">{{ForceCollection|Cal Alder|star=3}}</ref> was originally [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]],<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]],<ref name="CSWE-Kal'Shebbol">{{CSWECite|II|196|Kal'Shebbol}}</ref> located along the [[Trition Trade Route]]<ref name="CSWE-Kathol sector">{{CSWECite|II|203|Kathol sector}}</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]]</ref> at the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE-Kathol sector" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Alder eventually received assignment to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he had already served for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]], fighting in some of the Rebel Alliance's most perilous campaigns of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including the [[battle of Nentan]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> an effort to evacuate refugees from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Alder's expertise in terrain scouting and native creatures impressed Derlin, and his abilities made him among the first to arrive at Echo Base. As one of the finest forward scouts present,<ref name="Who's Who" /> Alder's duties included patrolling the facility's outer perimeter on the planet's icy wastes<ref name="SWE" /> under Derlin's command.<ref name="BTM" />

When base personnel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] went missing out in one of Hoth's brutally cold [[Standard day/Legends|nighttime]] blizzards during a routine scouting expedition in early [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Alder coordinated a search party for the two men.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Although Echo Base waited as long as possible before closing its protective shield doors for the night, in hopes that the two would return safely, Alder's responsibilities required him to report to Derlin that with Hoth's dropping [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] threatening the conditions of the base's interior, Skywalker and Solo had still not reported in. The situation forced Derlin to inform worried base leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] that the doors would have to be closed for the night, to which she reluctantly agreed. With her approval Alder carried out Derlin's order to close the base's shield doors, effectively trapping Skywalker and Solo out, leaving them to their fates. Further search efforts rescued both men the following morning.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="ESB novel" />

===Battle of Hoth and New Republic career===
Alder later fought during the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the large-scale Imperial invasion of Echo Base, serving along the main Rebel defensive perimeter, where he helped to organize [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] groups against the attacking line of Imperial assault [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Despite the heavy losses that the Rebellion suffered during the battle,<ref name="Who's Who" /> which proved to be the Alliance's worst battlefield defeat of the war,<ref name="CSWE-Battle of Hoth">{{CSWECite|II|62|Hoth, Battle of}}</ref> Alder survived the [[Ground warfare/Legends|engagement]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

Years later, in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="DarkStryder">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> Alder helped plan the [[DarkStryder Campaign]] in his home [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of Kathol under the leadership of [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic Special Forces]] agent Lieutenant [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> to topple the rogue Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="DarkStryder" /> The New Republic liberated the Kathol sector from Sarne's control largely through the efforts of the crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', who tracked down and ultimately defeated the warlord.<ref name="Endgame">''[[Endgame]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:AlderDerlin-ESB.png|thumb|right|300px|Cal Alder and Bren Derlin served together during some of the Rebel Alliance's most perilous campaigns.]]
Cal Alder was highly trained as an expert scout in his service to the Rebellion,<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> among the best stationed at Echo Base. His expertise in terrain and native creatures made him one of the earliest to arrive at the newly completed outpost,<ref name="Who's Who" /> where he was trained in riding a [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]],<ref name="Databank" /> one of Hoth's native beasts that the Rebels tamed for use as a mode of transportation.<ref name="GG3" />

When Alder informed Major Bren Derlin that Luke Skywalker and Han Solo still had not checked in from Hoth's exterior, he did so with crisp efficiency, initially unaware that Princess Leia Organa, whose thoughts rested heavily on her beleaguered friends, was nearby and could overhear his report. Derlin calmly raised a [[Limb/Legends|hand]] to cut him off mid-sentence in order to lower Alder's voice for the princess's benefit.<ref name="ESB" />

Alder had [[Color/Legends|bluish]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin.<ref name="BTM" />

==Equipment==
While on Hoth Alder wore the standard [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather armor]] of Echo Base personnel, including the set's [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]], [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]], [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|padded vest]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|lightweight tunic]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|gloves]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|leggings]], and [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|boots]].<ref name="ESB" /> His equipment also included a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]], which he wore [[Holster/Legends|holstered]] at his right hip,<ref name="Vintage Collection">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#068: Rebel Soldier (Echo Base Battle Gear)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVC68EchoBase.asp}}</ref> and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], used during the incident involving the missing Luke Skywalker.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
{{Quote|All patrols are now in except Skywalker and Solo, sir.|Cal Alder's alternate line from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization|<ref name="ESB novel" />}}
Cal Alder's character first appeared, unnamed, in [[Donald F. Glut]]'s [[1980]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB novel" /> released just prior to his inclusion in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> Actor [[Jack McKenzie]] portrayed Alder on-screen, credited only as "Deck Lieutenant" in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> However, this crediting should not confuse Alder with the character of [[Tamizander Rey]], also an Echo Base [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> whom Han Solo actually addresses as such in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> According to the book ''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]'', the Alder scene was filmed between [[May 22]] and [[May 29]], [[1979]].<ref name="Making of ESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The Alder character was first identified by name on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/calalder.gif "Cal Alder" card] as part of the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Hoth Limited" />

===Character development and inconsistencies===
Alder's backstory was greatly expanded on in the [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]," written by [[Josh Radke]]. The article connects Alder with information from ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'',<ref name="Who's Who" /> a [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure.<ref name="DarkStryder" /> This, in turn, is a connection drawing upon information<ref name="Who's Who" /> originally found on Alder's ''SW''CCG card, which identifies him as a native of the planet Kal'Shebbol,<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> a planet first created for ''The DarkStryder Campaign''.<ref name="DarkStryder" />

While the "Who's Who in Echo Base" article identifies Alder as being a lieutenant in his respective character entry, the "[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Corman Quien]]" entry within the same article lists Alder as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].<ref name="Who's Who" />
